Corrections to spec.md

The console writes .agent/review-answers.json into the worktree.

The dispatcher writes it. The web layer records an intent; it never writes into a worktree.

Why: web/app.py has no worktree path, and ADR 0003 forbids it.

Track

The plan session proposed default. Change it only when implement and review must run on another track.
